text.en:
The next 5 Hits within #e${8+#d} seconds of using your Class Ability seconds apply <strand/>Sever.

Applying <strand/>Sever refreshes the buff duration. Activates even while stowed.

The next 5 Hits within #e${8+#d} seconds of using your Class Ability apply <strand/>Sever to hit targets (even if they are currently immune to damage).

Applying <strand/>Sever refreshes the buff duration. Activates even while stowed.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
)

Using your Class Ability makes your next 5 Hits within #e${8+#d} seconds apply <strand/>Sever to targets (even if they are currently immune to damage).

Hitting a non-<strand/>Severed enemy refreshes the buff duration. Activates even while stowed.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
)

Using your Class Ability makes your next 5 Hits within #e${8+#d} seconds apply <strand/>Sever to targets. Activates even while stowed.

Hitting a non-<strand/>Severed enemy refreshes the buff duration. Works even if the target is immune to damage.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1? second.
)

Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for #e${8+#d} seconds.

While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-<strand/>Severed targets <strand/>Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)

Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.

If the <strand/>Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.
